item.title: In Lebanon, more than 50 medics have been killed by Israel. Some say they're targeted
item.summary: Lebanon says at least 54 health workers are among more than 1,400 people killed by Israel during the current invasion. Human rights groups say first responders are being targeted — something Israel denies.

item.title: Trump says U.S. military has rescued airman shot down over Iran
item.summary: A U.S. Air Force officer whose plane was shot down in Iran was rescued by U.S. forces early Sunday after evading capture for more than a day in enemy territory, President Trump announced on social media.

item.title: 'London Falling': A teenage imposter, an aging gangster and a body in the Thames
item.summary: In 2019, 19-year-old Zac Brettler leapt towards the River Thames from a fifth-floor luxury apartment in central London. Patrick Radden Keefe investigates the story of the teen's double life in a new book.

item.title: These rock-climbing fish can shimmy up a 50-foot waterfall
item.summary: New research from the Democratic Republic of Congo offers a behavioral and anatomical portrait of a species that can achieve surprising athletic feats.

item.title: Sunday Puzzle: "To Be Announced"
item.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe plays the puzzle with WUNC listener Andrew Patton and Weekend Edition Puzzlemaster Will Shortz

item.title: Natural disasters and political instability hampered U.S. museum attendance in 2025
item.summary: The Art Newspaper's latest annual study of "the world's 100 most visited art museums" also reveals signs of modest growth.

item.title: Judge halts Trump effort requiring colleges to show they don't consider race in admissions
item.summary: A federal judge on Saturday said the Trump Administration the demand to collect data from universities was rolled out in a "rushed and chaotic" manner.

item.title: Questions to help you get 'financially naked' with your partner
item.summary: Having "brutally honest conversations" about money can bring couples closer together, says Vivian Tu, a financial educator. She shares questions to ask your partner at every relationship stage.

item.title: More teens are getting hooked on gambling. Parents say it often goes undetected
item.summary: The explosion of online gambling and sports betting, as well as the advertising behind it, is attracting a growing number of young people, most of them boys.

item.title: After the Minnesota surge, ICE is moving to a quieter enforcement approach
